annotation.title_clean: AI solutions use in Latin America and the Caribbean 2025
annotation.title_en: AI solutions use in Latin America and the Caribbean 2025
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Jordan, V.; Poveda, L. (ECLAC Digital Development Observatory)
annotation.summary_en: ECLAC Digital Development Observatory data note using web traffic to measure AI solution adoption in 18 Latin American and Caribbean countries. The region over-indexes in usage, concentrated in six countries and in end-user generative AI. It recommends productive development policies, closing talent, infrastructure and data gaps, and using sandboxes and procurement.
key_provisions_or_claims: LAC accounts for 14% of global AI solution visits versus 11% of internet users.
Six countries account for 86% of regional AI web traffic.
Generative AI makes up 78% of regional visits; open-source and API use lag the global average.
Region risks becoming a net consumer of AI with growing dependence on external providers.
Recommends standards, interoperability, open source, innovative public procurement and regulatory sandboxes.
